title: Implement image assignment logic (3-tier priority: uploads > scraped > Pexels)
description: Implement src/lib/images/assign.ts which assigns images to each section using 3-tier priority: 1) Manual uploads from the batch media library (matched by filename convention), 2) Scraped images from the crawl, 3) Pexels API fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns sections with image URLs populated for all relevant sections
Priority order: manual uploads > scraped images > Pexels
Manual uploads matched by slot and industry from filename convention: `{slot}-{industry}-{descriptor}.{ext}`
Scraped images filtered to exclude tiny icons (skip images with w/h hints < 100px or src containing 'icon', 'logo', 'favicon')
Pexels used as last resort with industry-specific queries
No images left as empty strings if any tier has results

steps.details: Import `searchPhotos` from `./pexels`, `getImageQuery` from `./industry-queries`, repository media functions. Define `assignImages(sections: SiteSection[], prospect: Prospect, batchId: string): Promise<SiteSection[]>`.

For each section that needs an image (hero, gallery, about, etc.), call `getMediaBySlotAndIndustry(batchId, slot, prospect.industry)`. If found, use the file path as the image URL. Mark as 'used' to avoid reuse in the same batch.

From `prospect.scraped_raw`, get all page images. Filter: remove images where src contains 'icon', 'logo', 'favicon', 'sprite', or src is a data URI. Sort by appearing on the homepage first. Assign to sections that still need images.

For sections that still need images after tiers 1 and 2, call `searchPhotos(getImageQuery(prospect.industry, slot), 1)` per section. Assign the first result's URL. Make these calls sequentially (not parallel) to avoid rate limiting.

Test with a prospect that has an existing_url. Verify: scraped images are used where available, Pexels images fill in the rest. Test with a prospect without a URL — verify Pexels images are used for all slots.

technicalNotes: Image slots per section type: hero (1 image), gallery (4-8 images), about (1 image), services (optional per service), team (per member).
The gallery section may need multiple images — call Pexels multiple times with slight query variations if needed.
External image URLs from Pexels are downloaded to /public/images/ during export (TASK-86) so they work in the standalone Next.js project.
